name: San Vicente de la Barquera (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of light blue, white and light blue, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of San Vicente de la Barquera (a ship on blue within an inscribed bordure).
history: Municipal flag of San Vicente de la Barquera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: San Vicente de la Barquera arms — ship within an inscribed bordure
